intro: Mauritius has about 1.3 million people of Indian, African, Chinese and European descent.

chapters.title: People
text: About two-thirds have Indian ancestry. Mauritian Creole is spoken by almost everyone; English and French are widely used. Hindus are the largest religious group, with Christians and Muslims too.

chapters.title: Port Louis
text: Port Louis is the capital and main port.

keyTerms.meaning: A language formed from mixing languages.
